conditions: Simple point-only scenes, point labels and axes/grid disabled. Import_to_object_count includes page UI, file input, validation and frontend update. SVG rebuild timings are values reported by editor on draw. Chrome headless, cannot infer user device speeds.
current_design: resolver caches dependent point positions per draw; index map built once per paint
Debounced local autosave (~400 ms), flush on pagehide when uncontested
Undo at most 80 snapshots, bounded to 30 MiB for older snapshots
Import at most 10,000 objects, 20,000 samples per freehand path, 12 MB file input cap
Raster max 36 megapixels; restricted TikZ sample cap 2000
Bounded explicit function sampler, no GPU; raster resolution 1x–4x, 36 MP maximum and 16384 pixel side cap
Point click hit testing computes nearest visible point rather than rendering a separate invisible SVG disk per point
Point SVG primitives outside current viewport are conservatively omitted but remain in native JSON
Left list renders bounded 45px rows with overscan; scroll/search accesses all data
Cut06: multi-vertex anchor planning uses one shared resolver snapshot instead of creating and snapping vertices sequentially
Cut06: normal local save uses origin-scoped Web Locks where supported; unload path remains best effort
Cut10: bounded immutable explicit-plot path cache, 32 entries and 1.2M characters
Cut10: clip infinite lines to visible SVG before constructing geometry
Cut10: node-edge endpoint trims adapt to node-box boundaries, not static center offset
known_hotspots: 3,000 points exceed a 16.7 ms frame budget in the isolated renderer, so not 60 FPS at that scene size
Snap-to-anchor performs linear scan of visible points on pointer movement
Entire freehand paths serialize into snapshots and SVG on changes
Full SVG still rebuilds all visible geometry and path segments on every redraw
Virtual list consumes DOM proportional to viewport height, but search/filter still traverses all objects
Geometric point hit and anchor snapping still scan candidate points linearly

Fast indexed object lookup and dirty object updates
Parametric path simplification/LOD with precision toggles
Async import/render for large documents with cancellation
Workers/WebGL for dense scenes, only with measured benefits
